subject: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot & success criteria (OrbisData)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@orbisdata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot & success criteria (OrbisData)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo + the pilot outline we discussed. Below is a succinct proposed plan so your team can review with the stakeholders you mentioned (Samantha / data team).

High-level pilot objective:
- Validate Redwood’s inference latency and cost targets for OrbisData’s document search pipeline and ensure extraction quality meets your QA bar.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 180ms for 512-token queries under a 4qps steady load.
2) Cost: Effective token cost <= $0.003 per generated-unit after batching & caching (approx. modeling estimate).
3) Quality: End-to-end extraction F1 >= 0.84 on your 500-sample evaluation set (we’ll help run these evals).
4) Reliability: No more than 1% error rate (timeouts/errors) across pilot period.

Scope & deliverables (2-week pilot):
- Week 0: Access & env setup (data ingress checklist attached).
- Week 1: Run baseline captures, execute 3 evaluation prompts (we’ll bring a seeded prompt set), tune batching/kv-cache config.
- Week 2: Production-like run & acceptance report with latency/cost breakdown and recommended config for Dedicated or Private deployment.

Ownership & contacts:
- Internal: Irene (AE) — pilot owner for Orbis; Monica (Solutions Eng) — technical lead; Ben (Customer Success) — onboarding & ROI measurements.
- OrbisData: Alex — POC sponsor; Samantha — data / infra reviewer.

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the two-week window you prefer for the pilot start (we suggested Nov 30).
2) Confirm who on your infra team will provide S3 access and the contact for API allowlist.
3) Any regulatory constraints around data residency we should account for?

Attachments: Orbis_PoC_Playbook_v1.pdf (proposed tasks + timeline), data-access-checklist.xlsx (minimal data items we need).

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the kickoff once you confirm the start date.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@orbisdata.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbisdata.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot & success criteria (OrbisData)

Irene —

Appreciate the clear outline. A few quick clarifications from our side after reviewing the playbook: 

1) Timing — Nov 30 is tight for us due to a release freeze. Would Dec 7 work?
2) Latency definition — the 512-token figure is fine, but our typical queries are ~200 tokens; can you run an extra check for 200-token P95 target?
3) Data access — we can provide a masked S3 bucket. Our infra lead (cc’d Samantha) will confirm credentials and whether the bucket must be restricted by IP.
4) Quality acceptance — the 0.84 F1 target seems reasonable. Can you outline how we’ll run the evaluation (scripts, format) so we can replicate on our end?

Also: any objections to one of our engineers joining the kickoff for the first two days? They’re helpful for quick creds/permissions.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Product, OrbisData
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot & success criteria (OrbisData)

Thanks — copying our SRE/eng plan here. Notes: 

- Dec 7 start is OK; will adjust timeline to Dec 7–Dec 20 (two weeks + buffer).
- I’ll prepare two evaluation sets: a 200-token sample (n=400) and a 512-token sample (n=500). I’ll include scripts that compute precision/recall/F1 and a small notebook to reproduce the runs.
- For the P95 targets I’ll provide a simulated load-run from our test harness and include raw token-cost estimates per config (quantization + batching).
- We should ask Orbis if IP-restricted allowlist is required. If they require IP lock then Private deployment becomes more realistic; flagging to revenue ops for potential pricing impact.

Action items (internal):
- Monica: drop the evaluation scripts and runbook to the Drive link; prepare runbook for Dec 7 kickoff.
- Karthik: standby to join the first-day infra pairing to speed credentials / model loading.
- Ben: prepare a simple ROI slide (expected cost delta + performance delta) for the acceptance review.

Irene — I’ll get the artifacts by EOD today and attach the simulated-run CSVs.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@orbisdata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbisdata.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: proposed pilot & success criteria (OrbisData)

Alex / Samantha —

Dec 7 works — we’ve moved the kickoff to Monday, Dec 7 at 9:00am PST. I’ve created a short agenda and shared the Drive folder with the playbook & scripts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-PoC-Outline-OrbisData

Quick confirmation checklist for the kickoff: 
- S3 bucket details + placeholder credentials (Samantha to confirm)
- API allowlist or IP restrictions (Samantha)
- Who from Orbis will be the daily contact during the pilot (name + calendar availability)

Next steps on our side: Monica will upload the evaluation scripts & simulated run by EOD (link above), Karthik will join the first-day pairing, and Ben will circulate the ROI slide for the acceptance call on Dec 18.

If that all looks good I’ll send the calendar invite and a DocuSign statement-of-work (pilot-level) to formalize access and duration.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Orbis_PoC_Playbook_v1.pdf; Attachment: data-access-checklist.xlsx]
